notes.title: THE VOID IS HERE
notes.notes: [h1]THE VOID HAS COME[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489705/158fba0b868e16807a7f17470a0e46bb62dcfcaf.png"][/img][/p][p]A new secret level has appeared on Cursedland, will you be able to survive?[/p][p][/p][h1]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489705/9a782e78577aeb7a0001399d6710243ba80ff7ba.png"][/img][/p][p]You can unlock new achievemets for the new zones, and you have the Cursed-abecedary (you have to enter the Farlopa-castle to unllock it).[/p][p][/p][h1]LEVEL SELECTOR[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489705/4b66cc9fd1e2ab6f9f643aad477d9af9e8df42e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can now select a level to go to, in the Main Menu screen.[/p][p][/p][h1]THE MOON[/h1][p][/p][p]The moon level has been updated, now it is shorter than before.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Volume Fixed
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489705/3d03cec94c9dba7d3f7fba2f98e2664dd8a3e67b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489705/ff25958eb68efb7612e5f6056a84a9779d3f5404.png[/img][/url]Because of the volume of the music, i have added an options scene with a volume slider for the game.

Now you can low the volume in game.

notes.title: Cursedland is out May 16th.
notes.notes:
In a few weeks you will be able to finally play the las version of Cursedland, including 6 new levels, achievements and some easter eggs.

I hope that you will enjoy the game. :)
